note: RNSendSpans models the send-span ring in sdk/rocketnet_allocator.cpp (rn_span_round16, rn_span_place, rn_span_link, rn_span_unlink, rn_region_send_alloc_span, rn_region_send_free, rn_region_send_free_fragment, and the empty-ring reset in rn_region_reset): head, tail, first and last, the list in allocation order, frees in any order, wrap padding, tail == head meaning full, and the reset to 0 when empty; actions Alloc(l, d), Exhaust(l), Free(d) and Reset; invariants TypeOK, LiveSpansDisjoint, SpanInsideRing, Aligned, HeadIsOldestStart, ListInAllocationOrder, EmptyIsZero, FullAdmitsNothing, IdleAdmitsAnyMessage and LiveBetweenHeadAndTail; passing control MCRNSendSpans.cfg and reversed witnesses MCRNSendSpansBrokenFloorAtNewest.cfg (LiveSpansDisjoint) and MCRNSendSpansBrokenNoPadding.cfg (SpanInsideRing).

RNResendTiming models the resend timing of one reliable record: the delay min(rto, resend_interval) with no back-off in rn_window_ack_resend_delay (sdk/rocketnet_window_ack.h), rn_window_ack_resend and rn_window_ack_check_timeout (sdk/rocketnet_window_ack.cpp), the resend walk of rn_ordered_write (sdk/rocketnet_channel.cpp), rn_message_ordered_due and rn_message_connection_write (sdk/rocketnet_message_server.cpp), the RTO of rn_window_ack_on_ack, and the attempts rule of rocketnet_message_validate_config (sdk/rocketnet_config.cpp); actions Resend, Sample(r), Ack, Tick and Done; invariants TypeOK, ConfigAccepted, AttemptsBeforeTimeout and ResendGapBounded; passing control MCRNResendTiming.cfg and reversed witness MCRNResendTimingBrokenBackoff.cfg (AttemptsBeforeTimeout), replayed against the code by resend_timing_witness_replays (test_unit_resend_timing.cpp).

RNClientIo models the client I/O thread design of docs/CLIENT-IO.md for sdk/rocketnet_client_transport.cpp: the two send rings handed off by send_packets and reopened only after the I/O thread has sent them, each slot owner, the receive buffers exchanged by a publish and return handshake, the level-triggered wake, and stop, join and free in that order; actions Write, Commit, HandOff, Reopen, Swap, Stop, Join, Free, Arrive, IoSend, IoFinishRing, IoReceive, IoPublish, IoWait, IoWake, IoClearWake and IoExit; invariants TypeOK, NoReuseBeforeSent, ExposedStable and FreedOnlyAfterJoin, liveness HandedOffEventuallySent and StopEventuallyJoins; passing control MCRNClientIo.cfg and reversed witnesses MCRNClientIoBrokenReuseBeforeSent.cfg (NoReuseBeforeSent) and MCRNClientIoBrokenSwapWhileReading.cfg (ExposedStable). Owed: the code does not implement the design yet.
